bathtub: Is there a bathtub or just a shower?
Can you actually stretch out and relax in the tub?
Does the tub have jets or anything fancy?
Is the bathtub clean and modern looking?
Is there space near the tub to keep your stuff like soap or shampoo?
tv: Can I watch Netflix or stream stuff on the TV?
Is the TV big enough to see from the bed?
Is it on the wall or sitting on a table?
Can I plug in my laptop or device easily?
Is it a good quality TV or kind of old?
kettle: Is there a kettle in the room to make tea or coffee?
Can it make more than one cup at a time?
Does the kettle have any settings or is it just on/off?
Do they give you tea bags or coffee with it?
Is it a decent kettle or just something basic?
hairdryer: Do they give you a hairdryer in the room?
Is it strong enough or just one of those weak ones?
Does it have heat settings or just one speed?
Can you use it easily near a mirror?
Does it come with any attachments like a diffuser?
mirror: Is there a full-length mirror in the room?
Is the bathroom mirror good for doing makeup or shaving?
Do they have a small magnifying mirror?
Is there enough light near the mirror?
Does the mirror fog up after a shower?
